# coolify_database_backup (Resource)

A scheduled backup for a standalone database (docs: databases/backups), stored locally and optionally shipped to an S3 storage (`coolify_s3_storage`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_database_backup" "nightly" {
  database_uuid   = coolify_database.pg.uuid
  frequency       = "@daily"
  save_s3         = true
  s3_storage_uuid = coolify_s3_storage.backups.uuid

  retention_amount_locally = 3
  retention_days_s3        = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_uuid` (String) UUID of the database to back up. Changing it forces replacement.
- `frequency` (String) Cron expression (`0 3 * * *`) or shorthand (`@daily`…).

### Optional

- `databases_to_backup` (String) Comma-separated logical database names to back up.
- `dump_all` (Boolean) Dump the whole instance instead of selected logical databases.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `retention_amount_locally` (Number) Number of local backups to keep (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_amount_s3` (Number) Number of S3 backups to keep (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_days_locally` (Number) Days to keep local backups (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_days_s3` (Number) Days to keep S3 backups (0 = unlimited).
- `s3_storage_uuid` (String) UUID of the `coolify_s3_storage` target (required when `save_s3`).
- `save_s3` (Boolean) Also upload backups to S3. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (Number) Backup timeout in seconds (60–36000).

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_database_backup.example <database_uuid>/<backup_uuid>
```
